installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Velocity Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server

cd /mnt/server

USER_AGENT="pterodactyl-panel/1.0 (https://github.com/pterodactyl/panel)"

# PaperMC sunset the v2 API in favour of the "fill" v3 API, which requires a
# descriptive User-Agent. Versions are grouped newest-first with snapshots listed
# before their stable release, so scan them in order and take the first version
# that has a STABLE build (the same jar papermc.io serves on its downloads page).
VERSIONS="$(curl -s -H "User-Agent: ${USER_AGENT}" https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/velocity | jq -r '.versions | to_entries[] | .value[]')"

for VERSION in $VERSIONS; do
    BUILDS="$(curl -s -H "User-Agent: ${USER_AGENT}" "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/velocity/versions/${VERSION}/builds")"

    # Abort if the API returned an error payload instead of a build list.
    if echo "${BUILDS}" | jq -e '.ok == false' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "Error: $(echo "${BUILDS}" | jq -r '.message // "Unknown error"')"
        exit 1
    fi

    DOWNLOAD_URL="$(echo "${BUILDS}" | jq -r 'first(.[] | select(.channel == "STABLE") | .downloads."server:default".url) // "null"')"

    if [ "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" != "null" ]; then
        break
    fi
done

if [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ] || [ "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" == "null" ]; then
    echo "No stable Velocity build is available from the PaperMC API."
    exit 1
fi

echo -e "Downloading Velocity ${VERSION}..."
curl -o ${SERVER_JARFILE} "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" || { echo "Download failed."; exit 2; }

echo -e "Install Complete"
